axioms.text: Evaluate or specify observable realism from explicit causal world-state transitions rather than decorative imperfection.
Never infer personality, diagnosis, identity, honesty, or mental state from handwriting, appearance, wear, gesture, or other generated artifacts.
Consume persistent identity and relationship constraints from their owning system; do not redefine product canon inside this skill.
Reject consequential visible effects with no causal parent and reject causal cycles within a compiled episode.
A realism PASS is evidence only and never grants publish, merge, deploy, identity-mutation, policy-promotion, or other effect authority.
